name: Handmade sabai grass round tea coasters, set of 6 (Mayurbhanj, Odisha)
supplier_cost_note: Craft Vista Pvt Ltd, Baripada (Mayurbhanj, Odisha): handmade sabai grass tea coaster Rs 25/piece (natural, grey and multicolour listings; grey listing MOQ 100 pieces) x 6 = Rs 150 (IndiaMART / ExportersIndia, seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshots). Does NOT include a holder/box; most competitors include one. Other Odisha quotes: AK Smile Enterprise (Balasore) 4 in coasters Rs 120/set (set size unstated); Sigmascott Bhubaneswar natural set of 6 Rs 280 (unit ambiguous), MOQ 10; GB Oreole Bhadrak set of 6 + box Rs 350/set - at Rs 280-350 the item fails the margin target.
retail_observed: Sets of 6 sabai grass coasters: Rs 459 (Utkal Crafts, with box, Amazon.in, MRP 780); Rs 499 (Amazon.in, 'Handmade Sabai Grass Coaster Set of 6', MRP 920); Nestasia Rs 550; The Paizley Rs 575 (Flipkart); LOKLORE with storage box Rs 775 (Amazon.in); older Bhumee Creations listing Rs 779. Seen 2026-10-22 via search snapshots; Amazon product URLs not captured for each.

demand_signals.summary: At least 6 active sellers (LOKLORE, Bhumee Creations, Utkal Crafts, The Paizley, IvoryCharm, GSSRA) list sabai coaster sets of 6 at Rs 459-779; shows an established category, no sales volumes available

risks: Price-competitive: Rs 459-499 sets with a box already exist; we must add a holder/box or a gift sleeve, which raises cost (box not quoted)
At Rs 499 Shopify/Meesho sit right at 30%; Amazon/Flipkart pass with ~33-38%
MOQ 100 pieces (~17 sets) on grey listing; confirm MOQ for natural/multicolour
GST: HSN 4602; 5% assumed - CA to confirm

review.notes: Not competitive without a holder: sets of 6 WITH a storage box sell at Rs 494 (Utkalika Odisha) and Rs 499 on Amazon.in (MRP 920), while the no-holder sets we found are Nestasia Rs 550 and The India Craft House Rs 810 (brand-led); our Rs 499 no-holder set has no edge, and adding a holder kills the margin (cost Rs 200 at Rs 499 -> 18.8-26.8% on every channel; matching Rs 459 at Rs 150 cost -> 24-32%, Shopify/Meesho fail). Even at the base case Shopify is 29.8% and the price sits Rs 50 above the Rs 449 floor, so there is no room for returns from size/colour variation.
